closedByA84.title: Shield full-catalog evaluation could prune failed or unsupported assets
closedByA84.closure: Every active catalog asset remains in the denominator with one Basic, Pro and Advanced packet.

closedByA84.title: Not every provider listing and required field had a terminal state
closedByA84.closure: A84 requires one terminal row for every listing multiplied by every declared field family.

closedByA84.title: Quote, market cap and volume could be presented without a shared asset identity
closedByA84.closure: All field rows bind canonicalAssetId, listingId, provider family and exact packet identity.

closedByA84.title: Stale provider data could count as fresh tier evidence
closedByA84.closure: Stale observations are separately classified and cannot satisfy required fresh-field floors.

closedByA84.title: Provider conflicts lacked an explicit paid-tier stop condition
closedByA84.closure: Pro and Advanced reject unresolved conflict while Basic may only disclose it as bounded context.

closedByA84.title: Provider-family independence could be inflated by duplicate listings
closedByA84.closure: Tier readiness counts unique provider families rather than listing count.

closedByA84.title: Missing quote or kline results could disappear from coverage percentages
closedByA84.closure: Failed, rate-limited and unavailable results remain explicit terminal rows and blockers.

closedByA84.title: Basic Pro and Advanced had no single full-catalog monotonicity proof
closedByA84.closure: A84 verifies that stricter tiers cannot become ready when a lower tier for the same asset is blocked.

closedByA84.title: Four popup tabs could drift from the same field evidence
closedByA84.closure: Overview, Analysis, Market Impact and Whale Watch projections bind exact source field IDs and add no facts.

closedByA84.title: Basic could expose paid Market Impact or Whale Watch depth
closedByA84.closure: Basic popup keeps Market Impact and Whale Watch unavailable regardless of fixture coverage.

closedByA84.title: Offline functional readiness could be mistaken for production eligibility
closedByA84.closure: Every packet fixes productionEligible, provider rights, browser, LIVE and sale credit at zero or false.

closedByA84.title: A fixed fifty-case benchmark could be mislabeled as the complete provider catalog
closedByA84.closure: A84 executes a separate 318-asset full-catalog fixture and keeps real dynamic intake distinct.

closedByA84.title: No cryptographic aggregate linked observation rows to tier packets
closedByA84.closure: Every observation and packet is individually hashed and the complete runtime has one aggregate SHA-256.

closedByA84.title: Re-signed field and tier promotion mutations were not tested at full denominator
closedByA84.closure: A84 re-seals and rejects twelve semantic mutation families for every tier packet.

closedByA84.title: Provider outage, quota and schema failure states were not jointly represented
closedByA84.closure: The ledger includes AVAILABLE, STALE, CONFLICTED, FAILED, RATE_LIMITED and UNAVAILABLE terminal classes.

closedByA84.title: Real full-catalog evidence lacked an intake denominator
closedByA84.closure: A84 defines a fail-closed intake for provider catalogs, field snapshots, rights, browser and customer labels.

closedByA84.title: A84 could be promoted without exact A80 candidate binding
closedByA84.closure: All A84 results explicitly remain unbound to a verified A80 candidate and ineligible for promotion.

closedByA84.title: Current public network execution could be inferred from injected Response fixtures
closedByA84.closure: Execution mode is recorded as INJECTED_FIXTURE and currentPublicNetworkExecuted remains false.

closedByA84.title: Material field and evidence-family floors could be bypassed by page or claim filler
closedByA84.closure: Tier decisions recompute material fields and evidence families from resolved field states.

closedByA84.title: Packet identity substitution could survive after re-sealing
closedByA84.closure: Packet ID must equal the exact canonical asset and tier tuple and is revalidated after every mutation.

closedByA84.title: Current package metadata still pointed selected execution fields at a prior pass
closedByA84.closure: Current pass, completion-program and patch metadata are bound to A84 through the current release authority.

closedByA84.title: A83 descendant verifier recomputed frozen A83 payload against a legal A84 child tree
closedByA84.closure: Historical descendant verification preserves the frozen payload and verifies an exact hash-linked child chain to the current revision.

closedByA84.title: A83 product verifier hardcoded A83 as the permanently current source
closedByA84.closure: The verifier now validates the A83 plane while resolving current source, program and active pass through current authority.

closedByA84.title: A82 descendant verifier stopped at A83 and rejected later legal descendants
closedByA84.closure: A reusable descendant-chain verifier now walks every exact manifest link through A84 and future declared children.

closedByA84.title: A82 matrix verifier hardcoded the A83 program and active revision
closedByA84.closure: Current program, authority and active identity are resolved dynamically while the frozen A82 evidence plane remains exact.

closedByA84.title: A81 descendant verifier treated A83 as the terminal lineage node
closedByA84.closure: A81 lineage is verified as an ordered digest chain A81 through the current descendant without recomputing historical payloads.

closedByA84.title: A81 matrix verifier hardcoded A83 current and remaining-pass counters
closedByA84.closure: The verifier reads the current completion program and derives the remaining denominator from the authoritative current pass.

closedByA84.title: A80 release admission and descendant verifiers hardcoded A83 as current
closedByA84.closure: A80 admission still enforces exact prerequisites while current source identity and descendant lineage are resolved through authority.

closedByA84.title: A79 build/browser verifiers mixed historical A79 identity with a hardcoded A83 current source
closedByA84.closure: A79 keeps its frozen policy and receipts but verifies current source exactness and authority without a hardcoded terminal pass.

closedByA84.title: A57 current truth and approved-change ledger did not recognize A84
closedByA84.closure: A57 current-source truth is authority-bound and the protected hardening ledger explicitly records the A84 pass without changing protected UI/assets/engine bytes.

closedByA84.title: No reusable exact descendant-chain primitive existed, causing repeated supersession regressions
closedByA84.closure: One shared verifier validates manifest digest, parent revision, parent digest, no-promotion claims and final current authority for every descendant link.

closedByA84.title: Canonical current-status test required the roadmap to start with literal A83 text
closedByA84.closure: Roadmap precedence is verified against the authoritative current revision ID, while the A32 canonical section remains mandatory.

closedByA84.title: A63 staging orchestrator verifier hardcoded A83 as the current source
closedByA84.closure: A63 preserves its frozen staging policy but validates current source through the current release authority and active pass.

closedByA84.title: A59 budget verifier required A83 as the current source
closedByA84.closure: A59 now verifies that it remains the declared budget parent while accepting the authority-bound current descendant.

closedByA84.title: A46 protected-integrity verifier required the hardening ledger source to remain A83
closedByA84.closure: A46 validates the hardening ledger against the current authority-bound source revision while preserving all 1073 protected rows.

closedByA84.title: A77 clean-root verifier required A83 for authority, active pass and completion program
closedByA84.closure: A77 keeps its frozen genesis and governance truth while resolving every current identity field from the authoritative mirror.

closedByA84.title: A78 descendant verifier hardcoded A83 and reduced the current-root gate to 23/30
closedByA84.closure: A78 now uses the shared exact descendant chain and current-authority verifier; only genuine dependency/runtime blockers remain.

truthBoundary: A84 proves a deterministic injected full-catalog Shield denominator, terminal field accounting, tier monotonicity, popup evidence parity and semantic mutation resistance. It does not prove current public-network snapshots, provider rights, exact A80, production browser behavior, customer value, staging, LIVE or sale.
